title: cyperus pohlii subsp. bahiensis
intro: Cyperus pohlii subsp. bahiensis, commonly known as a type of sedge, is a plant species native to Brazil. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The plant is also valued for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antiseptic properties, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions, including infections and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus pohlii subsp. bahiensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
